about: The iOS connectivity and reliability matrix: one row per cell. `suite` names where it runs (rust: cmux-next-ios/rust `cargo test --workspace` on Linux; ios: CmuxMobileKit on the iOS simulator). `test` is the test's name as its runner prints it. `gate: true` cells fail the workflow (and so block a PR); `gate: false` cells are reported, and turned to true once they pass. Every cell asserts some of: reconnected within N seconds, no lost or duplicated messages, the list shown from cache meanwhile, a clear state shown, and (degenerate) the god variant within 1.2x of the small one. Pattern page: cmuxterm-hq docs/handbook/patterns/ios-connectivity-matrix.md.

cells.case: offline, then back (10 s and 8 h)
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after the network is back; 'Reconnecting…' meanwhile; backoff; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: network back while a retry dial hangs on the dead path
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after the network is back; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: network back with no path change (captive portal, VPN)
cells.asserts: reconnect <= longest backoff step + one dial

cells.case: Wi-Fi to cellular handoff (machine)
Wi-Fi to cellular handoff (WireGuard roam mid-stream)
airplane mode, then back (tunnel)
3 s outage while the Mac produces 10 vs 20,000 deltas
cells.asserts: every delta once and in order; link stays up; fresh list within 1.2x of the small backlog

cells.case: 3 s outage, 20,000 deltas, phone applies 1 ms per delta
cells.asserts: no delta lost; link up; fresh list within 1.2x of the small backlog

cells.case: 160 ms RTT, 3% of chunks stall 250 ms; 1 vs 1,000 workspaces
UDP blocked (captive or corporate network)
roam onto a network that blocks UDP
every service with UDP blocked
UDP-blocked mode redials once
distant network (relay only)
signaling socket replaced under a live session
background 1 min and 8 h, then active
cells.asserts: stale link replaced within one dial; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: resume with a silently dead link (controller)
cells.asserts: redial at once, no probe first

cells.case: link dies silently while in the foreground
killed and relaunched
list shown from cache at launch
cells.asserts: cached rows shown before the Mac answers

cells.case: list kept from cache when a refresh fails
memory warning while connected
Mac asleep 1 min and 8 h (presence offline), then wakes
cells.asserts: 'Offline', no dials while asleep; reconnect within one dial; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: Mac network asleep before its presence; wakes
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after wake; 8 h within 1.2x

cells.case: Mac asleep under a live link (silent stream)
cells.asserts: link reports closed within keepalive + timeout

cells.case: Mac wakes with a blackholed signaling socket
cells.asserts: signaling replaced, phone dial and echo complete

cells.case: Mac app (cmux-mobile-host) restarts under a live link
cells.asserts: reconnect <= 2 s after the host is back; never 'Offline'

cells.case: daemon (cmux-tui) restarts; 1 vs 5,000 workspaces
cells.asserts: open channel closes clearly; clear refusal while down; list < 1 s after; god within 1.2x

cells.case: Cloud VM paused and resumed
session list of 1, 100, 1,000 and 5,000
keystroke while 8 MB of tool output streams
cells.asserts: output whole and in order; keystroke RTT within 1.2x of 1 KB

cells.case: open another session while 8 MB of tool output streams
first pairing (scanned code)
a token alone opens nothing
expired access token
cells.asserts: silent retry with a fresh token

cells.case: phone the person refused (host side)
phone refused or revoked on the Mac (phone side)
cells.asserts: stops asking; waits for the person

cells.case: session revoked (no access token can be minted)
cells.asserts: 'Signed out' after one refresh, not 'Reconnecting…' forever; no dial

cells.case: session revoked (the service refuses the token at the dial, the refreshed one too)
cells.asserts: 'Signed out' after one refresh; no event dials again

cells.case: a signed-out Mac's link closed as idle, then shown again
cells.asserts: still 'Signed out'; no redial until a new sign-in

cells.case: the service refuses the token at the signaling upgrade (Rust link)
